description: Defines models, enums, and default settings for Doughnut chart widgets in the Thingsboard UI, including layout options, styling, and chart configuration functions.

classes.name: DoughnutWidgetSettings
classes.description: Interface extending LatestChartWidgetSettings with additional properties for layout, clockwise direction, and total value styling.

methods.name: doughnutDefaultSettings
methods.description: Creates default doughnut widget settings, configurable for horizontal layout, including font and color styles.

methods.name: doughnutPieChartSettings
methods.description: Generates pie chart configuration based on doughnut widget settings, including visual and tooltip options.
